limitations: This is a local spectral theorem at the normalized positive equilibrium. A full PDE Hopf bifurcation additionally needs simple-mode and nonlinear nondegeneracy hypotheses. Only integer Gamma orders are represented by a finite chain, and the fixed-mean limit is spectral rather than a nonlinear trajectory-convergence theorem.
